mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_itinerary_comment WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT c.comment_id, c.itinerary_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.nickname, u.profile_img FROM tb_itinerary_comment c JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_itinerary_comment ( itinerary_id, user_id, content ) VALUES ( #{itineraryId}, #{userId}, #{content} )
